mapper.select: SELECT f.up_region_id as area_id, f.up_region_name as area_name, a.instance_id as device_id, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT(b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT(b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name) END) AS device_name, f.custom_id as component_id, f.custom_name as component_name, f.up_region_id as bay_id, f.up_region_name as bay_name, f.device_id as main_device_id, f.device_name as main_device_name, j.up_dict as device_type, b.mete_type, b.meter_type, b.appearance_type, "" as save_type_list, k.dict_note as recognition_type_list, "" as phase, "" as device_info, "" as data_type, "" as lower_value, "" as upper_value, "" as video_pos FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON a.cruise_id = c.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON a.cruise_id = d.preset_id left join t_std_device f on a.device_id = f.device_id and a.custom_id = f.custom_id left join t_dict_business j on f.device_type = j.dict_code left join t_dict_business k on a.cruise_type = k.dict_code

select a.robot_name as patroldevice_name, a.robot_code as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, "" as use_unit, c.dict_note as device_source, a.commission_date as production_date, a.appearance_number as production_code, if(b.dict_code = 399, 0, 1) as istransport, '10' as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.light_ip is null AND a.lnferad_IP is null THEN '' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) > 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) = 0 THEN '2' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) = 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) > 0 THEN '1' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) AND locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) THEN '3' else '' end) as video_mode, '' as place, (CASE WHEN a.robot_position = 155 THEN '2' WHEN a.robot_position = 156 THEN '1' WHEN a.robot_position = 399 THEN '3' end) as type, '' as patroldevcie_info, '' as robots_code from t_robot_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.robot_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.robot_factory = c.dict_code

select a.camera_name as patroldevice_name, a.camera_id as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, "" as use_unit, c.dict_note as device_source, '' as production_date, '' as production_code, '' as istransport, if(a.is_control = 0, '11', '10') as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.camera_type = 205 THEN '1' WHEN a.camera_type = 206 THEN '2' end) as video_mode, '' as place, '10' as type, '' as patroldevice_info, '' as robots_code from t_camera_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.camera_model = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.vendor_id = c.dict_code

SELECT b.up_dict as type, a.task_id as task_code, a.task_name, a.task_level as priority, "3" as device_level, if(a.if_run = 174, a.start_time, "") as fixed_start_time, IFNULL(a.date_type, "") as time, "" as cycle_month, "" as cycle_week, "" as cycle_execute_time, "" as cycle_start_time, "" as cycle_end_time, "" as interval_number, "" as interval_type, if(c.c_state=240,1,0) isenable, "" as creator, "" as create_time from t_cruise_task a left join t_dict_business b on a.type = b.dict_code and b.col_name="plan_type" left join t_cruise_result c on a.task_id = c.task_id

select count(1) as totalNum, (select count(1) from t_cruise_result where execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and c_state = 240) as validNum from t_cruise_result where execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and c_state in (240,242,243,244)

SELECT count(1) as totalNum, count(t.deal_type) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info union all ( select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all ( select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) AS totalNum, sum(IF(detail.cruise_data_state = 254, 1, 0)) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_task_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON detail.task_result_id = result.task_result_id WHERE result.cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_data_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON result.cruise_result_id = detail.cruise_result_id AND result.cruise_id = detail.instance_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}
SELECT robot_id as id, robot_code as patrolDeviceCode, robot_name as patrolDeviceName, commission_date as commissionTime FROM t_robot_info WHERE robot_type IS NOT NULL
SELECT camera_id as id, camera_id as patrolDeviceCode, camera_name as patrolDeviceName, create_time as commissionTime FROM t_camera_info
SELECT robot_id as id, robot_code as patrolDeviceCode, robot_name as patrolDeviceName, commission_date as commissionTime FROM t_robot_info WHERE drone_type IS NOT NULL
select phote_path from t_robot_info where phote_path is not null limit 1
